Name: Staircase Spacing
Author: yadm18
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Staircase Spacing[/b][/size]
Keep ladders apart in the Mines and Skull Cavern[/center]

[line]

[heading]What it does[/heading]
Placing a staircase creates a ladder on that floor. If a ladder is already inside the 5×5 square centered on the tile you aim at, the placement is refused. That square is the tile you clicked plus two tiles in every direction.

The staircase stays in your inventory. The game shows:

[quote]There's already a staircase nearby.[/quote]
The game sometimes puts the new ladder on a nearby open stone instead of the exact tile you clicked. That spot is checked the same way.

[heading]Where it applies[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Mines and Skull Cavern.[/b] Ladders already on the floor count, including ones the mine spawned.[/*]
[*][b]Shafts.[/b] A hole in the floor does not block a nearby staircase.[/*]
[*][b]Volcano Dungeon.[/b] Unchanged. A staircase cannot be placed there.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Install[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this download into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b], or install the zip with Vortex.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
The mod folder should look like this:

[code]Mods/StaircaseSpacing/
  StaircaseSpacing.dll
  manifest.json
  README.md
  i18n/default.json[/code]
[heading]Turn it off[/heading]
The rule starts on.
[list]
[*]With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], open [b]Staircase Spacing[/b] and uncheck [b]Limit staircase spacing[/b]. The change applies immediately.[/*]
[*]Without that menu, edit [font=Courier New]Mods/StaircaseSpacing/config.json[/font] after the first launch and set [font=Courier New]"Enabled"[/font] to [font=Courier New]false[/font].[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. It only adds the in-game checkbox.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Changelog[/heading]
[b]1.0.0[/b]
[list]
[*]First release.[/*]
[/list]
